header: Dated entries down a line, in order
lead: Two to twenty milestones, each with its date, a heading and a short paragraph. The list is a real ordered list, so the sequence survives being read without any styling at all.

entries.title: The date sits above the heading
entries.text: The child's value field holds the year or date, and the unit beside it takes a qualifier such as a month or a quarter.

entries.title: The connecting line is a border
entries.text: Drawn on the entries themselves rather than as a separate rule, so it can never run past the last one.

entries.title: The last entry ends the line
entries.text: Its border goes transparent instead of the list gaining an exception — the dot still marks where the sequence stops.
